Yesterday it was "Compiling Pattern Matching to Good Decision Trees" by L. Maranget. Today I've been using it to build a bidirectional type inference/checking system that includes Rust-like enums and traits for a programming language I want to build. It's incredible. I understand the algorithms well enough now to feel like I can begin writing code that implements them in real projects.
